##### Project general facts

Zazen Gardens is a residential development by ZāZEN Properties designed around the principles of Integrative Well-Being Design. The award-winning project features a collection of one-, two- and three-bedroom residences, each crafted with the health and prosperity of residents as a priority. As a LEED Gold certified building, Zazen Gardens reflects a firm commitment to sustainability and green living, bringing physical, mental and emotional balance into everyday life.

Zazen Gardens offers an array of amenities designed to support holistic living, including a state-of-the-art gymnasium, adult and children's swimming pools, a residents' lounge, a jogging track, a children's play area, an entertainment and barbecue area and retail outlets. Extensive landscaping, recycling stations, EV charging stations and solar panels that supplement energy usage in common areas create an eco-friendly environment, while the thoughtful design helps residents and their families feel nurtured and energised.

Residences feature high ceilings in living rooms and bedrooms, premium tile flooring, elegantly proportioned window-walls, generous balconies and central air conditioning. Semi-open kitchens come with breakfast counters, quartz stone countertops and professional-standard built-in appliances, including a refrigerator, gas cooktop, oven, dishwasher and ventilation hood. Bathrooms feature vitrified porcelain tiles, combined shower systems, Vitra sanitary ware and LED-lit mirrors in master bathrooms, while custom-crafted wardrobes, walk-in closets, pre-wiring for high-speed internet and laundry rooms with fitted washing machines complete the semi-furnished offering.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is a family-oriented community in Dubai with unobstructed access to the rest of the city, placing hotels, shopping destinations, schools, play areas, workplaces, entertainment and leisure within easy reach.

The community is distinguished by its connectivity and community-focused amenities, offering a sustainable family environment that balances convenience with tranquillity. Landscaped spaces, everyday retail and essential services make it easy to enjoy a balanced lifestyle close to home.

Dubai's world-class infrastructure and robust regulations make it a leading city for tourism and business, while long-term Golden Visas available through real estate investment make it easier for families to settle. Al Furjan combines these strengths with a well-connected residential setting, giving it lasting appeal for end users and investors.
